title: Retired Codex handshakes clear deferred terminal and provisional identity state on watchdog expiry and reader exit
outcome: Exact owned expiry/reader-exit cleanup clears bounded deferred candidates and provisional/unresolved handshake state consistently with RPC failure cleanup; a newer request is never cleared.
acceptance: On a matching watchdog expiry or reader exit, clear deferred terminal candidates and provisional/unresolved handshake state alongside the existing request flags under the same ownership lock.
Focused checks cover owned expiry/reader exit and a superseding request; cleanup cannot settle a receipt, dispatch or replay provider work.
